Method of Attack: Information-stealing Trojan that steals saved login credentials from browsers, FTP, mail, and terminal programs and exfiltrates them to attackers' servers
Delivered via phishing emails with COVID-19 themed lures and ARJ attachments containing executables disguised as PDF files
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious ARJ attachments
Indicators of Compromise: ARJ archive files with password protection
Malicious executables disguised as PDF files in email attachments
